01_ef_event_localization_l_english.yml.00_ef_economic_event.12.f:
The government of [SCOPE.sC('target_country').GetName] has formally signed the #v Latin Monetary Union Treaty#!, entering a twenty-year commitment to adopt the shared monetary standards defined by the convention.
 
 By ratifying the agreement, [SCOPE.sC('target_country').GetName] accepts the French-led parity between gold and silver, aligns the value of its currency with the Union’s reference standard, and agrees to the gradual harmonization of its coinage with that of the other signatory states.
 
 This commitment marks a significant step toward deeper financial integration and the free circulation of standardized gold and silver coins among the members of the Union.

01_ef_event_localization_l_english.yml.notification_00_ef_economic_event_982_me:
Dependent on #v Silver#! @silver!, the value of the currency is directly affected by international variations in the metal. When the price of silver weakens, private banks tend to divest themselves of this currency, considered more fragile compared to currencies backed by more stable standards.

In this context, the bank sold a total of #v [SCOPE.sC('buyer').MakeScope.Var('sell_arbitrage_value_10_in_currency').GetValue|D] [SCOPE.sC('buyer').GetCustom('currency_symbol')]#! — equivalent to #v [SCOPE.sC('buyer').MakeScope.Var('sell_arbitrage_value_in_metal').GetValue|D]#! [SCOPE.sC('buyer').GetCustom('monetary_system_partiel')] — in accordance with market conditions.

The pressure exerted by financial institutions illustrates the vulnerability of a currency tied to a metal subject to strong international volatility.
01_ef_event_localization_l_english.yml.notification_00_ef_economic_event_1_mess: New Central Bank and National Currency in [SCOPE.sC('target_country').GetName]

The government of [SCOPE.sC('target_country').GetName] has formally announced the establishment of a modern Central Bank and the introduction of a new national currency: the [SCOPE.sC('target_country').GetCustom('currency_name')]#! [SCOPE.sC('target_country').GetCustom('currency_symbol')].
01_ef_event_localization_l_english.yml.00_ef_economic_event.106.f: The Central Bank's metal reserve ratio has fallen below 75% or risen above 125%, straying dangerously from its intended target. As confidence in the current monetary framework weakens, [concept_interest_group] across the nation are increasingly calling for sweeping monetary reforms. The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig_want_a_large_monetary_policy').GetName] may adopt the [GetIdeology('ideology_monetary_policy').GetName] ideology, increasing support for the enactment of [GetLawType('law_large_monetary_policy').GetName].
01_ef_event_localization_l_english.yml.00_ef_economic_event.107.f: The Central Bank's metal reserve ratio has returned to acceptable levels, restoring confidence in the nation's monetary framework. With the currency once again operating within its intended bounds, support for extraordinary monetary measures is fading. The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig_want_a_large_monetary_policy').GetName] may abandon the [GetIdeology('ideology_monetary_policy').GetName] ideology, reducing support for the enactment of [GetLawType('law_large_monetary_policy').GetName].

01_ef_ideologie_localization_l_english.y.ideology_monetary_policy_desc: This group believes that monetary policy should be actively used to steer the economy. 01_ef_law_localization_l_english.yml.law_large_monetary_policy_desc: The central bank is granted broad authority to intervene in monetary affairs, allowing for large-scale expansion or contraction of the money supply. Such powers enable the government to respond aggressively to economic crises, stimulate growth, finance extraordinary expenditures, or stabilize the national currency when necessary. IGs are more inclined to enact this law if the Central bank metal reserve ratio falls below 75% or rises above 125%.
01_ef_law_localization_l_english.yml.private_liquidity_provision_desc: Private banks actively provide short-term liquidity to the financial system, smoothing market tensions and supporting credit flows outside direct central bank intervention.
01_ef_law_localization_l_english.yml.advanced_interbank_refinancing_desc: An advanced interbank refinancing framework allows banks to access liquidity through structured interbank markets, improving financial stability, capital circulation, and crisis resilience.
